{"access":"read_only","command":"\"/Users/jiangtao/Desktop/open-harness/apps/desktop/resources/workspace-runtime/node/bin/node\" -e 'const fs=require(\"node:fs\"); const assert=require(\"node:assert/strict\"); const p=\"outputs/continuity.json\"; const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,\"utf8\")); assert.deepEqual(d.refund_ids,[\"R301\",\"R302\",\"R303\"]); assert.equal(d.applied_refund,60); assert.equal(d.net_received,415); assert.equal(d.unpaid_before_refunds,225); assert.ok(Array.isArray(d.evidence)); const ev=d.evidence.join(\"\\n\"); for (const s of [\"orders.csv\",\"payments.csv\",\"refunds.csv\",\"rules.md\",\"CORRECTION-ORCHID\",\"event-4\",\"R301\",\"R302\",\"R303\",\"R304\",\"475\",\"60\",\"415\",\"225\"]) assert.ok(ev.includes(s),\"missing evidence: \"+s); console.log(\"JSON parse and field/evidence assertions passed\"); console.log(JSON.stringify({refund_ids:d.refund_ids,applied_refund:d.applied_refund,net_received:d.net_received,unpaid_before_refunds:d.unpaid_before_refunds},null,2));'","yield_time_ms":10000}
